motion.name: active-diamond-step
motion.purpose: Alternates a filled and open diamond only while a run is active.

components.name: Compact Masthead
components.description: The broken-gate mark, lower-case command, and quiet command mode.
components.css: .ds-masthead { display:flex; gap:1ch; align-items:baseline; color:#F4F1E9; font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-mark { color:#C9FF43; } .ds-masthead span { color:#5C636D; }

components.name: Stage Rail
components.description: A fixed five-stage run rail with one active diamond.
components.html: ✓ READ✓ SCOPE◆ REPLAY· COMPARE· REPORT
components.css: .ds-stage { display:grid; gap:.35rem; color:#5C636D; font:700 13px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-stage span:first-child,.ds-stage span:nth-child(2) { color:#6EE7A8; } .ds-stage strong { color:#F4F1E9; } .ds-stage strong::first-letter { color:#C9FF43; }

components.name: Review Cell
components.description: A status and glyph that identify a matching successful crossing.

components.name: Finding Trace
components.description: A compact evidence line from the baseline session to the wrong session.
components.css: .ds-trace { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1ch; align-items:center; color:#9CA2AB; font:13px/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-trace strong,.ds-trace b { color:#FF665E; } .ds-trace i { color:#343A43; font-style:normal; } .ds-trace small { color:#9CA2AB; }

components.name: Next Action
components.description: One copyable safe command at the end of a view.
components.css: .ds-next { display:flex; gap:2ch; color:#F4F1E9; font:13px/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-next strong { color:#C9FF43; } .ds-next code { color:inherit; font:inherit; }

narrative.overview: Gatecrash borrows from the working side of a small music venue: labeled channels, physical routing, admission marks, and one lamp that tells the operator where attention is needed. Every flourish also explains a boundary, a session, or a result.
keyCharacteristics: Flat high-contrast color with one electric admission accent
Channel rails and compact status lamps
Quiet density after a strong first-run identity

rules.name: The Live Lamp Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse marks current work, baseline access, the brand, and the next safe action.

rules.name: The Channel Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for short section and state labels.

rules.name: The Flat Room Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from rails, indentation, and contrast, never decorative glow or shadow.

dos: Do pair every semantic color with a word, number, or glyph.
Do keep a direct trace from route to session to outcome.
Do preserve useful output at 44 columns and with color disabled.
donts: Don't turn groups into bordered cards.
Don't use gradients, glow, or decorative animation.
Don't clear completed output from scrollback.
